items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL bead aspirate/dispense into each of 96 wells followed by 10 mix cycles (20 uL); the 5 min incubation comment is recorded before the magnet comment.
Engage-magnet/5 min comment present; log shows 90 uL aspirated from each well to waste A1, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and 200 uL removed to waste for all 96 wells.
Comments for 5 min air dry, disengage magnet, 2 min incubation and re-engage are present; 50 uL water added and mixed 10 times per well in the log.
Log shows 45 uL aspirated from each sample well and dispensed into the matching elution_plate well (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Every well in every step has its own pick up tip and drop tip in the log, so no tip touches two samples.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all 13 steps with correct volumes and well pairing, and records the non-simulated steps with protocol.comment. Each sample well gets its own tip in every step, so there is no cross-contamination.
